The '''Hellcaster cannon''' was an anti-personnel repeating blaster cannon utilized on the [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]]. Although the Hellcaster cannon was considered highly effective in its role, the weapon used heavy elements that insured its ammunition was expensive and difficult to produce. Prolonged fire from the cannon demonstrated an ability to shred [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] barriers. Two [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|attempted]] to kill a [[Subject 1138|rogue clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] by utilizing the Hellcaster cannon in concert with [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. Both gunships failed and were destroyed by the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>
